content.heroHeading: Where Every Bride Finds Her Glow
content.heroSubtitle: Bespoke luxury bridal styling & signature makeup artistry crafted to celebrate your natural beauty, timeless grace, and unforgettable radiance.
content.aboutStory: Welcome to Glowroot. Founded with an unwavering passion for high-fashion elegance and bridal perfection, Glowroot by Ishita is dedicated to transforming each bride into the most radiant, authentic version of herself. We believe bridal makeup is not a mask—it is an intimate celebration of your individuality, bone structure, and innate allure.
content.aboutPhilosophy: Skin-first, dewy, and enduring. Ishita avoids thick cakiness, opting instead for luminous, featherlight textures that look ethereal in candlelight, daylight, and crisp 4K cinematography. Every look is custom-tailored to balance your lehenga, heirloom jewels, lighting conditions, and skin undertones.
content.aboutExperience: Over 6+ years of bridal artistry, 450+ bespoke bridal transformations across Delhi NCR, Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, and international destinations. Formally trained with premier master artists and certified in airbrush HD technique, delicate draping, and contemporary bridal hair design.
content.aboutWhyTrust: Exclusive one-bride-a-day dedication for marquee wedding events, 100% premium luxury makeup vanity (Dior, Charlotte Tilbury, Tom Ford, NARS, Chanel), strict hygiene certifications, and a serene, calming presence when you need it most.
content.availabilityNotice: Now accepting bookings for the 2026 – 2027 Wedding Season. Due to personalized commitment, dates are secured strictly on first-confirmed basis.

testimonials.reviewText: Ishita gave me the glow of my dreams! Everyone praised the natural glass-skin look.

Ishita is a magician! My makeup stayed completely immaculate through 8 hours of pheras, emotional moments, and dancing. I felt like royalty yet completely myself. Guests could not stop complimenting the glow!
From our trial to the big day, Ishita made me feel so relaxed. Her understanding of lighting, undertones, and subtle shimmer is unmatched. Best beauty decision of my entire wedding journey.
I normally wear zero makeup and was terrified of looking cakey. Ishita gave me a glass-skin finish with sultry winged eyes that looked breathtaking in every photograph. Truly a luxury experience!

services.name: Bridal Makeup
services.shortDescription: Signature bespoke bridal beauty designed for your wedding day, balancing regal heritage with luminous modern glass skin.
services.fullDescription: Our hallmark bridal experience includes complete skin prep with luxury serums, customized HD / airbrush foundation, precision eye artistry tailored to your lehenga and jewelry, mink lashes, bridal hair styling with fresh flowers or accessories, and meticulous dupatta draping. Designed to withstand humidity, emotional tears, and heavy lighting.
services.priceNote: Starting from ₹35,000 (Venue & destination charges as applicable)
includes: Full luxury skin prep & hydro-infusion mask
Designer bridal hair styling & floral setting

services.name: Engagement Makeup
services.shortDescription: Soft, romantic, ethereal aesthetics celebrating the dawn of your wedding celebrations with radiant, dreamy elegance.
services.fullDescription: Tailored for rings exchange, intimate ceremonies, or lavish ballroom soirées. A harmonious blend of delicate pastels or jewel tones, sculpted soft contouring, and romantic textured updos or Hollywood waves.
includes: Soft glam eye artistry & custom lashes

services.name: Reception Makeup
services.shortDescription: Glamorous, high-fashion statement aesthetics crafted for evening celebrations and red-carpet stage lighting.
services.fullDescription: Celebrate as newlyweds with a breathtaking evening look. High-impact highlight, sculpted bone structure, bold or gilded eyes, and sophisticated red-carpet hair that turns every head in the grand ballroom.
includes: Dramatic or classic winged eye artistry
Sleek or textured evening hair styling

services.name: Cocktail Makeup
services.shortDescription: Modern, chic, editorial beauty with sultry smoky eyes, glass skin, and trend-forward glamour for high-energy nights.
services.fullDescription: Perfect for Sangeet, Cocktail, or Mehendi after-parties. Focuses on party-proof, smudge-free makeup that moves with you on the dance floor while looking editorial and striking.
includes: Smoky or metallic chrome eye design
Chic modern textured pony, braid, or waves

services.shortDescription: Flawless luxury styling for bridesmaids, sisters of the bride & groom, mothers, and distinguished gala guests.
